module_summary: AXI4-lite NM-by-NS crossbar: per-master skid buffers and address decoders feed per-master write/read channel arbiters with linger timers, registered slave-side outputs, skid-buffered return paths and outstanding-transaction counters.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Per-master write-address valid entering the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Per-master write data captured by the W skid buffer and routed to slaves.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Per-master read-address valid entering the AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned to each master from the granted slave.

anchors.name: wgrant
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot write grant to a slave (or error slot); steers write routing.

anchors.name: rgrant
anchors.why: Per-master one-hot read grant to a slave (or error slot); steers read routing.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Per-master write address decoded to select the target slave.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read response valid to each master; decrements read pending count.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid to each master; decrements write pending count.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AW ready from the per-master skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code returned to master, error on unmapped address.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Registered write-address valid to each slave from the granted master.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Registered read-address valid to each slave from the granted master.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data forwarded to each slave from master selected by mwindex.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Slave read data muxed back to masters via srindex.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Registered B ready to slaves, dropped when master B path stalls.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Registered R ready to slaves, dropped when master R path stalls.

anchors.name: wrequest
anchors.why: Per-master decoded one-hot slave request for writes, input to arbitration.

anchors.name: rrequest
anchors.why: Per-master decoded one-hot slave request for reads, input to arbitration.

anchors.name: swgrant
anchors.why: Per-master flag that a write channel grant is held.

anchors.name: srgrant
anchors.why: Per-master flag that a read channel grant is held.

anchors.name: mwgrant
anchors.why: Per-slave flag that some master holds its write channel; gates slave outputs.

anchors.name: mrgrant
anchors.why: Per-slave flag that some master holds its read channel; gates slave outputs.

anchors.name: swindex
anchors.why: Per-master index of granted write slave; selects B response and stall signals.

anchors.name: srindex
anchors.why: Per-master index of granted read slave; selects read data/response.

anchors.name: mwindex
anchors.why: Per-slave index of granted write master; selects AW/W data onto slave port.

anchors.name: mrindex
anchors.why: Per-slave index of granted read master; selects AR address onto slave port.

anchors.name: slave_awaccepts
anchors.why: Gates AW transfer: requires grant, not full, matching request, slave not stalled.

anchors.name: slave_waccepts
anchors.why: Gates W transfer: requires grant, expected write data, no downstream stall.

anchors.name: slave_raccepts
anchors.why: Gates AR transfer: requires grant, not full, matching request, no stall.

anchors.name: wrequested
anchors.why: Priority chain marking slaves already claimed by lower-index masters for writes.

anchors.name: rrequested
anchors.why: Priority chain marking slaves already claimed by lower-index masters for reads.

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].stay_on_channel
anchors.why: Holds write grant while requests or outstanding transactions remain.

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].requested_channel_is_available
anchors.why: Requested slave is free; triggers write grant switch.

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].leave_channel
anchors.why: Releases write grant after linger expires or another master asks.

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_WRITE_REQUESTS[*].WRITE_LINGER.linger_counter
anchors.why: Counts idle cycles before tearing down a write grant.

anchors.name: ARBITRATE_READ_REQUESTS[*].READ_LINGER.linger_counter
anchors.why: Counts idle cycles before tearing down a read grant.

anchors.name: w_awvalid
anchors.why: Decoded AW valid per master after skid/decoder, gated by not full.

anchors.name: w_wvalid
anchors.why: Write-data valid per master from W skid buffer.

anchors.name: w_arvalid
anchors.why: Decoded AR valid per master after skid/decoder, gated by not full.

anchors.name: r_bvalid
anchors.why: B return skid flag holding a response while master stalls.

anchors.name: r_rvalid
anchors.why: R return skid flag holding a response while master stalls.

anchors.name: r_rdata
anchors.why: Skid register holding read data while master R channel stalls.

anchors.name: COUNT_PENDING[*].awpending
anchors.why: Outstanding write count per master; drives swempty/swfull for grant hold.

anchors.name: COUNT_PENDING[*].rpending
anchors.why: Outstanding read count per master; drives srempty/srfull for grant hold.

anchors.name: COUNT_PENDING[*].missing_wdata
anchors.why: Counts AW accepted without matching W data yet.

anchors.name: COUNT_PENDING[*].r_wdata_expected
anchors.why: Flags that write data is expected; enables slave_waccepts.

anchors.name: swfull
anchors.why: Write pending counter full; blocks new AW requests.

anchors.name: swempty
anchors.why: No outstanding writes; allows grant release and re-arbitration.

anchors.name: srfull
anchors.why: Read pending counter full; blocks new AR requests.

anchors.name: srempty
anchors.why: No outstanding reads; allows grant release and re-arbitration.

groups.name: write_request_decode
groups.description: Per-master AW/W skid buffers and address decoder producing one-hot write slave requests.

groups.name: read_request_decode
groups.description: Per-master AR skid buffer and address decoder producing one-hot read slave requests.

groups.name: write_arbiter
groups.description: Per-master write channel grant with priority chain, linger timer and slave/master indices.

groups.name: read_arbiter
groups.description: Per-master read channel grant with priority chain, linger timer and slave/master indices.

groups.name: slave_write_outputs
groups.description: Registered AW/W/B-ready outputs per slave sourced from master chosen by mwindex.

groups.name: slave_read_outputs
groups.description: Registered AR/R-ready outputs per slave sourced from master chosen by mrindex.

groups.name: return_channels
groups.description: B and R responses muxed by swindex/srindex with skid registers and error responses.

groups.name: pending_counters
groups.description: Per-master outstanding read/write counters with full/empty flags holding grants.
